maintenance_led.reason: Outpatient therapy and psychiatry visits for patients are treatment services, not repair or maintenance of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes mainly from commercial insurers such as Blue Cross plans and patients; Medicare plans are a smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by hiring clinicians and opening outpatient clinics across 35 states, with acquisitions of practices a smaller part.

mission_critical.reason: Patients can move to other therapists or psychiatrists; switching has some continuity friction but no regulatory or technical lock-in.

notes: Serial acquirer is a judgment call; the company historically bought many practices but now grows mostly organically.
